evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep launches directly into confirmation: 'Let me confirm pickup address is at 1100 South Lamar...' — no time-box framing or promise of dependable quote, no wait for customer agreement before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep moves straight to logistics probing: 'Let's say that thank you and are there any additional rooms or spaces...'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer mentions 'I'm getting rid of the desk' and 'I have a chair on the balcony' — rep acknowledges with 'okay' but never asks 'tell me more about that' or follows up on either item.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection summary offered at any point.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floors/stories (second floor), number of rooms (one bedroom), walking distance (50 feet parking to elevator, 100 feet elevator to unit), additional rooms (balcony with one chair), special considerations (Peloton bike requiring two movers), additional stops (storage unit + destination house) — all covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep never asks 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes — 'normally for a one bedroom apartment we see fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?' Customer confirms yes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full. Range given ($945–$1,155 for 4.5–5.5 hours) and personalized to move specifics: 'since we're coming from a second floor with elevator access. However, there will be a long walk from the parking to your unit and we are dropping off everything into a storage unit, plus another drop-off into a two story house.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Fee transparency: 'everything is included to that gas and truck taxes, insurance, all the wraps and pads... No, he didn't fees of any type. No credit card fees, no terrible fees.' Plus commitment framing: 'we do have a minimum of two and a half hour so after that minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After estimate is given, customer says 'Uh-huh. Okay.' and rep immediately pivots to booking without asking if it feels fair.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep never asks 'Does that put those to rest?' or any version of confirming the two promises are settled — because the two promises were never delivered.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway. Rep asks 'do you have any questions before I let you know' — an empty, automatic close-out question, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' variation offered.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full. 'So with that, would you like to be on the schedule for October 11th?' — plainly asked without an easy out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Yes. 'So, I can definitely put you here on our schedule, no deposit is required... we, you are free to cancel or reschedule.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (October 11th), arrival window (8:30–9:00 AM), pickup address (1100 South Lamar Unit 2226), destination address (1903 East Seventeenth Street Unit A). Missing: phone number confirmation, crew size confirmation (discussed verbally but not confirmed in booking details), notes left for crew about customer concerns (rep mentions storage unit address still needed but does not summarize move concerns for the crew).

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, elevator access, walking distances, balcony item, Peloton bike, multiple stops, driveway vs. street parking) and delivered a personalized, anchored estimate tied directly to those specifics without overselling.
coaching_note: Never skip Section 2 — ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' before any probing, and follow up two layers deep on whatever the customer raises; you also missed both Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and Damage Coverage) entirely, plus the 'Does that feel fair?' pause, all three of which are load-bearing conversion moments on every call.
